title: Square of Sorted Array - Solution
approach: Compare squares at left and right pointers and place the larger square at the end of the output array.
intuition: Given an integer array nums sorted in non-decreasing order, return an array of the squares of each number sorted in non-decreasing order.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Compare squares at left and right pointers and place the larger square at the end of the output array.
common_mistakes: Use two pointers at both ends of the array and fill the result array backwards.
